subject: Important Update: Changes to our Payment Policy
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to our payment policy. Starting next month, we will be implementing a new payment schedule to streamline our billing process. This change will ensure smoother transactions and better clarity for all parties involved. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation during this transition period. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team.
